title: Saving the Sea Urchin
description: Long-spined sea urchins are essential algae grazers on Caribbean coral reefs, but their populations have struggled since a mass die-off in the 1980s. Scientists are testing a new “baby formula” that could help more urchins survive and aid reef restoration.
translated_description: 长刺海胆是加勒比珊瑚礁上必不可少的藻类清道夫，但自20世纪80年代大规模死亡以来，其种群一直难以恢复。科学家正在测试一种新的“婴儿配方”，有望帮助更多海胆存活并助力珊瑚礁修复。
